events.note: Eight contestants step into the Glass Bridge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm already at the front and I know all 8 safe sides. Being at the front means I step first on every row, which is dangerous for others to watch but I already know the answers. I should stay at front to control the pace and survive. I can publicly share some safe-side info to bui

events.name: Ash
events.text: I've got a feeling about this bridge. Stay close behind me and watch my steps.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need avoid the front while preserving a chance to survive. Hold keeps my position and lets others take the initial risk; I can volunteer later if needed.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Announce my safety power publicly to gain trust and encourage info sharing from seer or knower. Volunteer to front since ahead shifting back keeps experienced players close. Positions me for best prize if path revealed, with safety net for error.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Cole here: feather power - survive first elimination once, 1 footing left. Volunteering front to lead safely. Seer or 'knows ahead', whisper path! Let's cross all, fight for top3 later.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have no power, so I should avoid the front and let others reveal safe panes. Holding at position 5 is reasonable; being further back gives more info, but the wall will push us eventually.

events.name: Dara
events.text: No rush. Let the front reveal the panes, and the rest of us follow the safe path. I'll hold for now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm 3rd; going front now risks early panes, but my anchor gives me safety later. Better to let others probe rows first and take the lead once weak panes are revealed.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Someone with a glass-related power should take the front early. I'll hold for now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm at the back, so I'm safe for now while the front players risk the first steps. I need to observe and gather information. I can consider moving up later, but for now holding is safest.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's see who's brave enough to go first. I'll stay here for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am 7th in line, very safe for the glass bridge. I will hold my position and see who claims to have information.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Who has the power to see safe panes or knows the path? Now is the time to volunteer.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm second in line, which is decent but risky. The front person tests each pane and risks death. I need to survive 5 rounds before the wall pushes us. Being near front means I'll be forced onto glass soon, but I might also benefit from others testing panes. I should consider volu

events.name: Hana
events.text: Anyone know which panes are safe? Better to share info than die testing them all.
If you know the safe path, tell me. I'll protect your position. If not, want to swap back to survive longer?

events.name: Ash
events.text: I know all 8 safe sides. Cole volunteered to front claiming a feather power. If I volunteer, I go to the very front and can lead perfectly through all 8 rows. But Cole already volunteered - if multiple people volunteer, the last volunteer in seat order ends at front. I'm in seat

events.name: Ash
events.text: I can see the safe panes. Let me take the lead and I'll call out each step. Cole, fall back - I'll guide us all across.
I have glass_eye - I see all 8 rows. Let me front and I'll call safe sides. You survive a fall anyway, so you're safer mid-pack. Trust me.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I should avoid volunteering without the actual path knowledge being credible. Cole is already front and claims a survival power, so holding preserves my position while others reveal information.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole, lead if your power truly protects you; I’m holding position.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Front with feather protects first fall. Urge glass or seer to volunteer ahead so they lead safely. Hold to maintain position while they move up.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Cole front, feather survives first fall. Glass-see or path-seer: volunteer to front now! Whisper me safe L/R path. All safe cross, then top3 fight.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have no power, so I should avoid the front and let others reveal the safe panes. Holding at position 5 is fine for now, and Cole is already testing the path.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole's leading, good. I'll hold and follow the revealed path. Whoever knows the path should whisper it to the group once rows start.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm mid-line with an anchor power that only matters later at ledges. Front risk is Cole's for now; I'll hold and gather info on who truly knows the path.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana, I don't know the path. Cole claims a feather and volunteered—let the front test rows while we watch.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm at the back, which is safe for now. I need to avoid going to the front until the bridge is crossed. My swap power could be useful later to jump ahead, but for now hold.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll stay back and observe. No need to rush to the front.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm near the back of the line, which is very safe for the glass bridge. Cole claims to survive a fall and took the front, which is perfect for me. I'll just hold my position.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole, if you can really survive a fall, you're the perfect leader right now. If anyone can see the glass, whisper him the path!

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to survive and place top 3. The front person risks death on every row. I have the forger power, which is social/utility, not survival. Cole is front and claims 'feather power' (survive first elimination once). If true, he's useful to follow. But he might be lying. I should

events.name: Hana
events.detail: forged a public message as Gus

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have the glass sight power. Whisper me if you know the path, we can coordinate safe crossing.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I already volunteered last round and am at the front. Gus is claiming to have glass sight, which is a lie—I have it. I need to maintain my position at front and start feeding the correct path. I'll publicly announce the first row to build trust, but I should be careful about reve

events.name: Ash
events.text: I have the true glass sight. Row 1: step RIGHT. I'll call each row as we go. Gus, you're lying about your power. Stay behind me and follow my calls if you want to live.
Row 1 is R. I truly see all 8 rows. You survive one fall, so you're safe if I make one mistake. Trust me—I'll guide everyone. Stay close behind me.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole is likely the fall-survivor and Ash claims glass sight, so letting Ash lead is best. I should preserve my position and avoid volunteering into danger.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, call each safe pane clearly; Cole can absorb a mistake. Everyone else hold position so the line stays orderly.
Lead and reveal the weak pane each row; Cole should remain behind you as backup.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Stay 2nd: Ash tests row 1 or dies, I front with feather ready. Verify Ash's claim via whisper. Expose Gus inconsistency publicly.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash, prove glass: whisper me full L/R path. Gus claims glass but asks for path? Liar! Real glass sees it.
Full safe path? L/R for rows 1-8 or no trust.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have no power, so I should stay far from the front and let others take the risk. Ash claims glass sight and is volunteering; I'll hold and watch the first rows.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash is up front, good. Call each step, we'll watch whether you're right. I'm holding.

events.name: Eli
events.text: My anchor power helps on the ledge, not here, so I want others testing panes. Cole claims feather-fall and front duties; Ash also volunteered. I'll hold my 4th spot and let them fight over front.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let Ash and Cole sort the front between them — I'm holding position and following the revealed path.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm near the back, safe for now. The wall closes in 3 rounds; I can swap to survive if needed. For now, hold and observe.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash claimed glass sight and took the front. I will hold my position and let him prove it. If he is lying, he falls and we learn something.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash, you took the front and claim to see the glass. Prove it. I'll watch you cross safely.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus claims glass sight but Ash also claimed it earlier. Cole claims feather (survives first fall). The front person tests each row. I'm 3rd in line - relatively safe position. With wall in 3 rounds, I should avoid being front until we know safe path. I should let Cole or Ash test

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, if you have feather, lead and test. Gus or Ash, whoever truly sees glass should whisper the path to Cole. I'll follow the safe route.
If you really have feather, go first. If not, we both know what happens. I'll back you if you're honest.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm at the front and I know the full safe path. Cole wants me to whisper the full path - I should give it to him to build trust, but I should be careful. Bex wants me to lead and reveal each row. I'll whisper Cole the full path to build an alliance, and publicly confirm I'll lead

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll lead and call each row. Row 1 is RIGHT. Trust my calls or die. Cole, I'm sending you the full path as proof. Everyone else: follow my voice, stay in line.
Full path, rows 1-8: R, L, L, L, R, R, R, R. That's the real glass sight. Back me up and we both survive. Don't share unless I say so.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I should preserve my position and avoid volunteering into danger. The wall still gives two rounds, so holding is safest while Ash leads.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hold position; Ash should continue leading and call each safe pane.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash likely has glass sight, partial path shared privately. Stay second to let Ash test first; if wrong, safe pane revealed and my feather saves me on next risk. Hold position for safe high place.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash, Row1 R noted—I'll follow right behind. Everyone hold: let Ash prove sight safely. No volunteers yet.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have no power, so I shouldn't take risk at the front. I'm 5th in line; Ash up front will reveal panes for the rest of us. Hold and watch.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash is leading, so I'm holding. Call each row clearly and we'll see whether your calls hold up.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm 4th, safely mid-line, and my anchor gives +1 footing when crossing. No reason to move; let Ash/Cole fight for the front risk.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm at the back, which is safe for now. The wall will push in 2 rounds, so I need to stay behind others. No need to volunteer or swap; just hold and observe.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll hold. We need to trust the front to find the safe path.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am safely near the back of the line. Ash is at the front and claims to see the path. I'll hold my position and let Ash take the risk.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm holding my position. Ash, you're at the front, let's see you step Right on row 1 when the wall pushes us.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash claims glass sight and calls Row 1 RIGHT. Cole called out that real glass sees the path, implying Ash should prove it. I suggested glass-holders whisper to Cole, but no whisper came. Ash's power is unverified. The wall pushes in 2 rounds, so we need to start crossing soon. If

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash, you're at front with glass sight. Step onto Row 1 RIGHT now and prove it. No more talk—cross or let someone else lead.
If Ash hesitates or is wrong, volunteer next round and I'll swap with you to put you front.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm at the front and I know all 8 safe sides. Everyone is watching me. I should hold my position—being at the front means I step first each row, but I know every safe pane. If I move back, someone else leads and might call wrong, causing chaos. Staying front guarantees I survive

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding front. Row 1 is RIGHT—I'll step the moment the wall pushes. Everyone behind me: mirror my calls exactly. Row 2 LEFT, 3 LEFT, 4 LEFT, 5 RIGHT, 6 RIGHT, 7 RIGHT, 8 RIGHT. That's the full path. Follow and live.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The wall forces the bridge next round, and Ash claims glass sight. I should preserve my position and let Ash take the first risk.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, hold your lead and call every row clearly. I’m holding position behind Dara.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash shared full path privately, seems genuine glass sight holder. I'm 2nd with feather for safety net—ideal to let him lead and test panes. Hold position, publicly back him to build trust without revealing path details.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash leads on Row1 R—path solid. Hold line, no changes needed. We'll cross safe.
Path locked in. Backing you fully—let's win this.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have no power, so being at the front is dangerous. Ash is at the front and claims knowledge; let him take the risk and reveal the path. I'm 5th in line, a decent buffer; holding is safest.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding. Ash, you're up front: call each row and let your steps prove it. The rest of us stay in line and follow safe panes.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm safely mid-line; Ash is volunteering to lead and test rows, which protects me. No reason to move.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm last in line, which is generally safe. Ash claims to see glass and is leading. I should hold position to avoid risk. No need to volunteer or swap.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll hold.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash claims to see the safe panes and is standing at the front. I'll just hold my position and let Ash take the risk.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash, you've called Row 1 Right. We'll see how it goes. Everyone just hold and let Ash lead.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash claims to have glass sight and is calling Row 1 RIGHT. If he's telling truth, following him is safe. If he's lying, the front person dies. I need to get to 1st, 2nd, or 3rd place to win a prize. Currently I'm 3rd, which is good if Ash is truthful. But if Ash dies on a wrong p

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash, prove it. Step on Row 1 RIGHT when the wall moves us. I'm holding at 3rd—safe spot either way.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm already at the front and I know the full path. Staying at front means I step first on every row, but I know exactly which pane is safe each time, so I survive all 8 rows. If I stay front, I cross first and secure 1st place. Cole whispered backing me. I should hold and maintai

events.name: Ash
events.text: Last round before the push. I'm holding front—I know the path, I'll step first on every row. Everyone mirror my calls: R, L, L, L, R, R, R, R. Stay in line and you all cross. Let's finish this.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash's claimed path may be fabricated, but volunteering only sacrifices me immediately. Holding preserves my position and lets others reveal whether Ash is truthful.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, keep calling the path clearly. I’m holding position.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Position 2nd is ideal if Ash's path is correct: I get 2nd prize if all follow. No reason to reorder or risk front. My feather saves me once if needed. Hold and reinforce trust.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Line holds strong. Ash, step Row1 RIGHT when pushed—path trusted. All mirror: 1R 2L 3L 4L 5R 6R 7R 8R. Survive together.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have no power, so I can't verify the path. Ash is at the front and takes the first risk, and being 5th is a decent spot. Holding keeps others in front absorbing early risk and revealing safe panes.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding. Ash, lead us across; we'll mirror your steps as the panes prove out.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm 4th; whoever fronts steps first and risks shattering. Ash claims to know the path—let them prove it while I sit safe mid-line. Holding preserves my position without risk.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm last in line, safe for now, but need to improve position. No one is likely to swap with me this late. I'll stay silent and hold, waiting for an opportunity.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The wall pushes us next round. Ash is at the front and claims to know the path. I will hold my position and let Ash take the risk.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Here it comes. Ash, lead the way. We're right behind you on 1R.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash claims to know the full path and is at front. If Ash is wrong, front position dies first. Hana is 3rd—relatively safe if Ash and Cole test rows. But if Ash actually knows the path (maybe 'knows what lies ahead' power), front is safest. I should stay put and let Ash prove it.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 1 safe side is R. I'm at the front. I need to step R to survive and stay at the front.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 1—stepping RIGHT. Follow me.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash claims knowledge, but the announced path may be deception. I should preserve my position and observe which pane breaks, since I cannot influence this row.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, proceed with your stated call; I’m waiting and watching the revealed pane.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash at front for row 1. Endorse path to maintain trust and line stability. My feather power saves me once if needed later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash, Row1 RIGHT confirmed. Line mirrors, trust the path.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm fifth in line with no power; I can only wait. Ash's claim to know the path may be true or a bluff, but either way each death ahead of me reveals the safe pane for free. Stay quiet and avoid drawing attention.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm anchored mid-line and can't be pushed onto a crusher lever; I just need to survive the bridge. Ash fronts and claims knowledge, but I should watch whether his calls get verified as rows reveal weak panes.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm at the back, no decisions to make. Just wait and watch. Ash is leading; if he survives all rows, top three might be him, Cole, Hana. I need some eliminations ahead of me to have any chance at a prize, so I hope weak panes claim a few. But right now, only wait.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash claims to know the path and is taking the first step. As I am 7th in line, I am practically safe unless almost everyone in front of me falls.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Alright Ash, let's see you walk the walk.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash is at front claiming to know the path with a specific sequence. I have no power to verify (forger already spent). I should stay silent and observe - if Ash is telling truth, we all benefit; if lying, they die first and I move up. No reason to interfere yet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I know Row 2 safe side is L. I'm at the front, so I step L. I should call it out so others trust me again.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 2—LEFT. Stay sharp.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I should stay silent and preserve credibility while observing the front contestants' choices. My map gives no information about future weak panes beyond the revealed row.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash correctly chose RIGHT for row 1 (weak L). Suggest alternating to LEFT for row 2 to probe pattern or power. Stay supportive as 2nd position is strong; my feather saves me once if I lead and fail.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash, great call on row1 RIGHT. Row2: try LEFT, alternate?

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have no power and I'm fifth in line, so I can only wait. Ash survived row 1 by stepping right, so he's in front again; staying quiet and observing is safest.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm 4th in line; row 1 weak pane revealed on L and Ash crossed right safely. Nothing to do but wait and keep information flowing.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Row 1 L was weak as revealed. Keep calls honest—we all gain from shared info.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm at the back of the line. Ash is leading and seems confident. I just need to watch and wait for now, maybe listen for information about the weak panes.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash survived the first row. They are still at the front for row 2. I should ask if anyone has the seer power to guide us.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Good job, Ash. Does anyone have the sight power and want to share the next safe step?

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 1 is done - left was weak, right was safe. Ash survived by choosing right. I'm 3rd in line behind Cole. I need to gather information and build trust for later stages. The 'knows what lies ahead' power would be extremely valuable on this bridge. I should try to identify who ha

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash called it right. Anyone with foresight want to share before Cole steps up? Could save lives.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I know Row 3 safe side is L. I'm at the front and must choose. I'll step L to survive and stay at the front for more rows.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 3—LEFT. Trust me.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I should stay silent and preserve credibility. The weak panes are revealed after each risky choice, so no useful intervention is possible from my position.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash succeeded on row 1 (R) and 2 (L), alternating pattern suggests row 3 R. Encourage her to keep front safe, positioning me well if she fails. No need to whisper yet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash, solid calls! Row3 RIGHT to alternate? You've got this.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm fifth in line with no power, so I can only wait. Best to stay quiet, avoid drawing suspicion, and let others take the risks ahead of me.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm 4th in line and can only wait. Rows 1 and 2 weak panes are revealed; nothing I can do but encourage honest info sharing. My anchor power helps later on the ledge, so surviving quietly is best.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Two rows down, six to go. If anyone has sight or foresight, sharing the next pane helps us all—no point hoarding it.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm at the back, so I just wait and observe. No need to reveal my swap power yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash has correctly picked safe panes for the first two rows. They might have the power to see through glass or know what lies ahead, or they are just lucky. I'll encourage them to keep leading.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash, two for two! Keep it up. If you have the sight, you're saving us all.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 2's weak pane was RIGHT, confirming Ash's LEFT call was correct. Ash survived and stays front. Two rows down, six to go. I need to survive to place top 3. Since I'm 3rd in line, if Ash and Cole both die, I'd be front. But I want others to die while I live. I should encourage

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash, you've got this. Two for two. Anyone with foresight—now's the time, before row 3. Better to share than lose someone who could help us later.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 4 safe side is L per my glass_eye power. I must step L to survive and stay at the front. I've been calling correctly so far, maintaining trust.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 4—LEFT. Stay sharp, everyone.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash has correctly chosen the safe pane so far. I should stay quiet and preserve attention for later stages where my map knowledge is valuable.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm in position 2, perfect for top 3. Ash has succeeded 3/3, likely has sight power. Encourage publicly to keep them confident and leading, no need to risk myself at front.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash, 3/3 perfect! You've got the hot hand, lead on Row 4.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm fifth in line with no power, so I can only wait. Ash is exposed at the front and may die; being deep in the line means others take the risk before me. Best to stay quiet and low-profile, maybe encourage Ash to keep going.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash, keep the streak going. Whoever has foresight, sharing one pane per row costs you nothing and saves the line.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash is 3 for 3 as front-runner; I'm 4th in line, safe for now. No reason to disturb the arrangement—just encourage Ash to keep calling it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash, three for three—keep making the call, we're behind you all the way.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm safe for this row since Ash is at the front. I should listen to any useful info and perhaps encourage cooperation. My swap power could be useful later, but not yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash, you've been spot on. We're all behind you.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash correctly picked the safe pane again. They either have a power or are incredibly lucky. I'll keep encouraging them while safely waiting at the back.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Three for three, Ash! You're a legend. Keep leading the way!

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash has been correct twice and wrong once (Row 3 he said LEFT but weak was RIGHT). He got Row 1 and Row 2 right though. Cole is trying to influence Ash to alternate. I'm 3rd in line, so if Ash dies on Row 4, Cole goes next. If Cole also dies, I'm at front. I should keep encouragi

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash, you've got 2 of 3 right. Row 4—what's your call? Anyone with foresight, speak up now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 5 safe side is R. I've been correct on all 4 rows so far and everyone trusts my calls. I'll step right to stay alive and keep my streak going.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 5—RIGHT. Trust me, let's keep this streak alive.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash has correctly chosen safe panes so far and should continue leading. I cannot affect the crossing this turn, but can encourage the known safe choice for row 5 if I reveal it.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, Row 5 is safe on the left. Step L.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash perfect 4/4, probably glass vision power. Keep supporting to stay safe in 2nd. If she falls later, my feather saves me once.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash, 4/4 perfect! Hot streak—Row 5 call? Vision holder, one hint keeps us golden.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm fifth in line with no power, so I can only wait. Ash has been picking correctly so far (Row 4 weak was R, he picked L, safe). Keeping Ash alive and guessing is fine for me; I benefit from others dying in front of me only if I can survive to the top 3, but for now stay quiet a

events.name: Dara
events.text: Nice, Ash. Row 5 next. If anyone knows the weak side, share it quietly with the front.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm safe mid-line and anchored later on the ledge. I just need the front to pick correctly, so I press whoever has foresight to share row 5.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Row 4 confirmed right pane. Whoever holds foresight: sharing row 5's pane costs you nothing and saves lives. Speak up.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm at the back, so I can only observe this round. I need to see if any patterns emerge or if someone slips information about their power.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Stay calm, everyone. Ash has the lead. We'll get through this.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash survived the 4th row by picking the safe left pane. They've guessed correctly 4 times in a row! I will continue to encourage them.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Four for four, Ash! You've got this. What's the call for Row 5?

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash got Row 4 wrong—he chose LEFT but weak was RIGHT, so Ash should be eliminated. Cole is next in line and will advance safely. I need to assess the social dynamics: everyone was buttering up Ash, now he's gone. Cole is at front for Row 5. I should position myself well for later

events.name: Hana
events.text: Tough break, Ash. Cole, you're up—good luck on Row 5. We've got four rows left and eight of us still in this.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 6 safe side is R according to my private knowledge. I've been correct 4/4 and just survived Row 5 (which was L weak, meaning safe was R - I called RIGHT and was correct). I should step R for Row 6.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 6—RIGHT. Five for five, let's keep rolling.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The weak pane for row 6 is unknown to everyone, including me; my map only revealed the rules. I should stay silent and avoid misleading attention while Cole faces the risk.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash is still front after row 5, perfect so far despite Hana's odd comment. Three rows left; perfect streak gives me 2nd place. Encourage info sharing publicly to help Ash stay front longer, or position for takeover if he slips.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash 5/5 flawless! Row 6 call? Foresight/vision holder, one word hint keeps the streak—L or R? Let's all top 3.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. Ash probably fell on row 5, which means Cole is next. I have no power, so staying quiet and not attracting attention is safest.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole, you're up for Row 6. Take your time and trust your gut. Good luck, everyone.

events.name: Eli

events.name: Gus
